name: GeGLU MLP
tagline: Gated Linear Unit with GELU gate; hidden dim ~ (8/3)d to keep parameters near GELU baseline.
diff_from_baseline: Shazeer, 'GLU Variants Improve Transformer' (2020). Used in Gemma and other modern LMs; multiplicative gating consistently improves perplexity over plain GELU at matched parameters.

name: ReLU squared MLP
tagline: Two-layer MLP with ReLU(x)^2 in place of GELU; same 4d expansion as the baseline.
diff_from_baseline: So et al., 'Primer: Searching for Efficient Transformers' (2021). Inspired by modded-nanogpt records; cheap drop-in replacement for GELU often matching/improving perplexity.

name: SwiGLU MLP
tagline: Gated Linear Unit with SiLU gate; hidden dim ~ (8/3)d to match parameter count of the GELU baseline.
diff_from_baseline: Shazeer, 'GLU Variants Improve Transformer' (2020); the FFN choice in LLaMA, PaLM, Mistral, Llama-2/3. Default modern FFN baseline against which new MLP variants are compared.
